## Decision changed

What user decision or failure does this improve? What is the baseline?

## Evidence and scope

Separate current contracts, reported results, reproduced runs, hypotheses,
and unknowns. Link primary sources with revision/date for research changes.
Explain why any finding belongs in runtime guidance rather than the archive.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes; relevant failures and limits are recorded.
- [ ] Behavior-changing skill edits have independent scenario evidence.
- [ ] Website edits have a Jekyll build and generated-site check.
- [ ] Installation/metadata changes have a package-discovery smoke check.
- [ ] No duplicated research feed, tautological test, or unrun capability claim.
- [ ] Version changes and historical evidence are handled explicitly.

Mark non-applicable items with a reason. A checked box is an assertion, not
the evidence; include commands/results or artifact links above.
